hero.subtitle: Hi, I'm Gábor Németh — freelance fullstack developer based in Budapest, specializing in Laravel and React. I also craft clean, fast websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, from small business showcases to complex SaaS systems. Available for project-based and hourly work.

about.titleHighlight: and I've been learning and building projects ever since.
paragraphs: I studied frontend and later fullstack development at Ruander Educational Center, alongside Udemy courses — and by the end, web development had become a real passion.

Since then I've worked on freelance projects, built a real-time 3D manufacturing monitoring system for Robert Bosch, and worked on Packli, a Hungarian parcel logistics platform — first as an employee, and now I continue that work on a freelance basis. It's the project I'm proudest of: leading the webshop integration work and building an invoice cost-verification feature from scratch.

I currently have open capacity as a freelancer: I'm happy to take on new websites, web applications, or other development projects, either on a project basis or hourly — rates are discussed directly by message.
Outside of work, I enjoy building my own projects end to end: a shopping list app, and a few websites.
about.quote: I enjoy building web applications that are fast, transparent, and reliable.

faq.description: Everything you need to know about technologies, pricing models, timelines, and the development process.

items.question: Which technologies do you work with, and how do you pick the right stack?
items.answer: Depending on project goals: for clean, ultra-fast showcase and business websites, I use HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. For complex business web applications, client portals, and SaaS platforms, I use Laravel (PHP) REST APIs paired with modern React frontends and reliable MySQL databases.

items.question: Do you work on a fixed-price project basis or hourly rates?
items.answer: I offer both arrangements. For well-defined projects (showcase websites, landing pages, specific apps), I provide a transparent, upfront fixed-price quote. For ongoing development, system integrations, maintenance, and bug fixes, I work on an hourly rate.

items.question: Do you handle e-commerce and API integrations (couriers, invoicing)?
items.answer: Yes, with hands-on SaaS platform experience at Packli, I connect online stores (Shopify, WooCommerce, UNAS) with external services including courier systems (GLS, FoxPost, MPL, Packeta), online invoicing (Billingo, Számlázz.hu), and custom REST APIs.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website or web application?
items.answer: A responsive business website (HTML/CSS/JS) usually takes 1–2 weeks once content is finalized. A custom Laravel + React web application or API integration typically takes 3–6 weeks depending on feature complexity.

items.question: Do you provide post-launch maintenance and support?
items.answer: Absolutely. I don't leave clients on their own after launch: I assist with domain and hosting configuration, security updates, Core Web Vitals speed optimization, and ongoing feature additions.

items.question: How do we get started working together?
items.answer: The first step is a free, informal consultation (via email, phone, or a 15-minute Google Meet call on my calendar). We'll discuss your requirements, goals, and deadlines, followed by a detailed, personalized proposal.
